visual_brief.subject: AWS moves agent spending limits outside the model loop
verified_context: Incarna agents pay for individual inference requests while Amazon Bedrock AgentCore payments manages signing and budget policy.
A payment session has a spending ceiling and expiry that the agent's code and prompt cannot raise.
The production case used request-level x402 payments to access model inference through BlockRun.
visual_brief.editorial_idea: An agent may choose among service paths, but a separate physical gate determines how much value can pass.
visual_brief.visual_metaphor: A finite reservoir releases a few payment tokens through an external calibrated aperture into branching inference channels; agency is implied by the route choice rather than a character.

candidate_notes.A: Constitution-compliant. A finite stone reservoir feeds a few tokens through a heavy external aperture into three broad service paths. The control relationship is clear, though the distant spheres and cloud landscape are slightly busier than the selected composition.
candidate_notes.B: Selected. A suspended bowl and aperture meter a finite token stream into three sculptural channels and separate service chambers. The external control point, spatial separation, and route choice remain clear without a character, interface, or diagram-first treatment.
candidate_notes.C: Constitution-compliant. The cliff-side reservoir and mounted gate create a strong finite-resource metaphor, but the broad riverbed reads less specifically as request-level authorization than the selected aperture.

crop_review.article_desktop: 1100 x 591 center-cover review preserves the suspended reservoir, descending finite token stream, and all three service chambers.
crop_review.article_mobile: 359 x 193 center-cover review retains the metering aperture and central branch as the dominant relationship.
crop_review.thumbnail: 320 x 164 review preserves the external aperture and three-way channel silhouette without relying on the smallest tokens.

golden_reference_comparison: Direct review beside the GPT-6 Sol/Luna routing image and greedy-decoding precision image shows consistent warm paper, charcoal and terracotta route language, sparse landscape, sculptural spheres, controlled curves, and strong negative space. Candidate B adds more architectural depth while preserving the reference set's clear route metaphor and thumbnail silhouette.
